name: Forward Arm Raise
description: Raise the arm forward to shoulder height and above to catch bubbles

name: Lateral Arm Raise
description: Raise the arm sideways to reach bubbles on the left or right

name: Overhead Reach
description: Reach above the head to pop the highest bubbles

name: Seated Knee Extension
description: Extend the knee from a seated position to kick a ball

name: Mini Squat
description: Perform a shallow squat to duck under obstacles

name: Step Up
description: Step up onto a platform to climb the path

name: Wrist Flexion and Extension
description: Bend the wrist up and down to steer the magic wand

name: Forearm Rotation
description: Rotate the forearm palm up and palm down to turn magic keys
